note: Four logical engine groups with three specialist seats each. Agents share a task-routed model pool; model choice is based on capability, privacy, latency, cost, free quota and availability. Local phone models are optional low-risk/offline helpers, not frontier reasoning workers.
credential_policy: Store credentials in a secure secret manager or protected runtime environment; never commit secrets to this repository.
routing_policy: Choose model per task using capability, context window, latency, cost, rate limits, and availability. Record provider/model/version with each run.

frontier_escalation.purpose: Hard reasoning, complex engineering and high-impact QA
frontier_escalation.reason: Paid calls prohibited by creator's initial budget policy; queue tasks that cannot be safely handled by verified free capacity.

hosted_throughput.purpose: Routine agent tasks using verified free API quota

local_fallback.purpose: Private/offline low-risk tasks through a verified local endpoint

local_device_constraints.initial_model_target: approximately 1B-2B quantized GGUF, subject to measured memory fit
local_device_constraints.note: External USB storage adds capacity but does not increase RAM or compute.

provider_selection_note: No provider or model is enabled yet. Configure only after verifying current free API eligibility, quota, model ID, terms and protocol. No app subscription is assumed to include API access.
